title: 第25章 迷灵之瞳第26章 幻灵脉
slug: 万古第一神第7596章第三轮
content_zh:
让那黑色漩涡一吸，李天命摔得七荤八素。
“这里是？”
他马上爬了起来，发现自己竟然在一间密室当中。
这里四面都是黑色墙壁，脚下的石板也格外坚硬，只有天花板上有一条圆形通道，通道的墙壁是青铜材质，应该就是那口井。
“我应该是在井下。”
他的眼睛迅速扫过周围，在这封闭的密室之中，他总共找到了两样东西。
一个是刚才从上方掉下来的神源，另外一个东西摆在他的眼前。
那好像是一个白玉球体，浑圆洁白，散发着晶莹的光芒。
正是这白玉圆球，将周围完全照亮，让这密室之中不至于一抹黑。
“你看这是什么？”
李天命将小黄鸡从伴生空间里带出来。
说实话他觉得这白玉圆球有些诡异，所以不敢轻举妄动。
“这里果然有东西？”
小黄鸡围绕那白玉圆球转了一圈，最后道：“还挺古怪，你自己摸索，把神源给我，我已经迫不及待要进化了。”
“就在这里面？”
“不然呢，你爹还在外面呢，谁知道他们什么时候会杀进来。”
小黄鸡翻白眼道。
炼化神源进化，这个过程主要由伴生兽进行。
如果进化成功，再次修炼的时候，伴生兽提升的血脉能力还会再次改造御兽师。
这进化过程，李天命只需要在边上护法就可以了。

“他们当我是一阶伴生兽，肯定以为我炼化不了这神源。
殊不知，我所谓的进化，其实更多是一种突破自我的血脉枷锁。”
小黄鸡鄙夷得意道。
“得了，别吹了。”
李天命把神源交给它，当然，他一点不担心小黄鸡会搞不定这神源。
虽然他听说，伴生兽吸收神源进化的过程变数很多，基本需要长辈护法帮助。
历史上很多进化失败的案例，甚至还有进化过程死亡的例子。
年轻人的伴生兽基本上不敢单独进化，但他感觉这永恒炼狱凤凰应该没这问题，它连灵矿都能生吃。
小黄鸡拿到了神源，无比欢快，那眼神就能孩童得到心爱的玩具似的。
“你先琢磨一下这圆球，没问题我再开始。”
别看它没心没肺的，其实还挺细心，神源在手还能忍住。
李天命早也迫不及待了，他现在就站在那白玉圆球边上。
“这口井以神源为钥匙，进来之后，只有这白玉圆球，那么这东西的价值，一定是神源的数倍才对。”
李天命道。
“那也要看，你有没有造化能得到它。”
“嗯。”
李天命点了点头，他做好了准备，伸出手碰触那白玉圆球，触手感觉冰凉，但没有任何排斥之感。
于是他将这白玉圆球拿起来，放在眼前端详。
只见这白玉圆球十分纯净圆滑，表面上没有任何的瑕疵，李天命转了几圈，感觉这就像是一个普通的玉石，似乎没什么古怪的东西。
content_en:
Let the black vortex suck in, and Li Tianming fell to pieces.
"Is this here?"
He immediately got up and found that he was in a secret room.
There are black walls on all sides, and the stone slabs under the feet are also extremely hard. There is only a circular passage on the ceiling. The walls of the passage are made of bronze, which should be the well.
"I should be down there."
His eyes quickly scanned the surroundings, and he found a total of two things in this closed secret room.
One is the divine source that just fell from above, and the other thing is placed in front of him.
It looked like a white jade sphere, round and white, exuding crystal light.
正是这白玉圆球，将周围完全照亮，让这密室之中不至于一抹黑。
"What do you think this is?"
Li Tianming took the little yellow chicken out of the companion space.
To be honest, he thought the white jade ball was a bit strange, so he didn't dare to act rashly.
"Is there really something here?"
The little yellow chicken circled around the white jade ball, and finally said: "It's quite weird. You can explore it yourself and give me the source of the gods. I can't wait to evolve."
"In here?"
"Otherwise, your father is still outside. Who knows when they will come in."
The little yellow chicken rolled his eyes.
Refining the divine source and evolving, this process is mainly carried out by companion beasts.
If the evolution is successful, when practicing again, the companion beast's improved bloodline ability will transform the beast master again.
During this evolutionary process, Li Tianming only needed to be on the side to protect him.
“They thought I was a first-order companion beast, and they must have thought that I couldn’t refine this divine source.
As everyone knows, what I call evolution is actually more of a way to break through the shackles of my own bloodline. "
The little yellow chicken said proudly with disdain.
"Come on, stop bragging."
Li Tianming handed the divine source to it. Of course, he was not worried that the little yellow chicken would not be able to handle the divine source.
Although he heard that there are many variables in the process of companion beasts absorbing the divine source and evolving, and they basically need the help of elder guardians.
There are many cases of evolution failure in history, and there are even examples of the death of the evolutionary process.
The young man's companion beast basically did not dare to evolve alone, but he felt that this eternal purgatory phoenix should not have this problem, it can even eat spiritual minerals raw.
The little yellow chicken was extremely happy when he got the divine source. His eyes looked like a child getting his beloved toy.
"You need to think about the ball first. If it's ok, I'll start again."
Even though it seems heartless, it is actually quite careful, and it can still hold back even with the divine source in hand.
Li Tianming couldn't wait any longer. He was now standing next to the white jade ball.
"This well uses the divine source as the key. After entering, there is only this white jade ball, so the value of this thing must be several times that of the divine source."
Li Tianming said.
"That also depends on whether you are lucky enough to get it."
"Yeah."
Li Tianming nodded. He was ready and stretched out his hand to touch the white jade ball. His tentacles felt cold, but there was no feeling of rejection.
So he picked up the white jade ball and put it in front of his eyes to examine it.
I saw that the white jade ball was very pure and smooth, without any flaws on the surface. Li Tianming turned it around a few times and felt that it was like an ordinary jade stone, and there seemed to be nothing weird about it.
